discordIpc.title: Discord is blocking the connection
discordIpc.description: Discord was probably started as administrator, while your browser and Nowly Desktop were not. Windows then stops Nowly from talking to Discord, so your activity no longer shows.
discordIpc.step1: Quit Discord completely, including from its icon in the notification area.
discordIpc.step2: Right-click the Discord shortcut, open Properties, then the Compatibility tab, and untick "Run this program as an administrator".
discordIpc.step3: Start Discord normally, then click Reconnect.
discordIpc.safety: No need to run your browser or Nowly as administrator: it would not help and it is less safe.
discordIpc.stillBlocked: Discord is still blocking the connection. Make sure it is fully closed, then start it normally.
discordIpc.resolvedDescription: All good. Nowly can show your activity on Discord again.
discordIpc.alertDescription: Discord is running as administrator. See how to fix it.
discordIpc.checkHint: Discord is running as administrator and blocks Nowly.
